# Spinner

<p class="gls-text-lead">Create an animated loading spinner.</p>

## Usage

To create a spinner, add the `gls-spinner` attribute to a block element.

```html
<div gls-spinner></div>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div gls-spinner></div>
</div>

```html
<div gls-spinner></div>
```

## Ratio

Add the `ratio: 3` parameter to the `gls-spinner` attribute to triple its size – or any other number, depending on how big you want the spinner to be.

```html
<div gls-spinner="ratio: 3"></div>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<span class="gls-margin-small-right" gls-spinner="ratio: 3"></span>
<span gls-spinner="ratio: 4.5"></span>
</div>

```html
<span class="gls-margin-small-right" gls-spinner="ratio: 3"></span>
<span gls-spinner="ratio: 4.5"></span>
```

***

## Accessibility

The Spinner component automatically sets the appropriate WAI-ARIA roles, states and properties.

- The *spinner* has the `status` role.
